title: Human Activity Recognition in Videos
description: Video classification on 12 classes of the UCF101 dataset — 14 frames extracted per clip with OpenCV, transfer learning with ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50, EfficientNetB0 and ConvNeXt using a two-phase training (frozen backbone, then fine-tuning), and per-video predictions by averaging frame probabilities. A near-perfect test score led us to identify data leakage between clips of the same scene, a key lesson in evaluation design. Three-person Machine Learning project at ECE Paris.
